description: This file contains unit tests for the HeaderTranslator class, verifying its behavior in translating between external headers and internal DittoHeaders, handling null and empty values, case insensitivity, and retention of known headers.

classes.name: HeaderTranslatorTest
classes.description: A test class containing various unit tests for verifying HeaderTranslator's behavior.

methods.name: testCaseInsensitivity
methods.description: Verifies that headers are correctly normalized to be case-insensitive.

methods.name: testNullValues
methods.description: Checks handling of null header values during translation.

methods.name: tryToTranslateNullExternalHeadersToDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures that passing null external headers throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: translateEmptyExternalHeadersToDittoHeaders
methods.description: Verifies that translating an empty external headers map results in an empty DittoHeaders object.

methods.name: translateExternalOnlyHeadersToDittoHeaders
methods.description: Tests that headers which are only external-specific are ignored during translation.

methods.name: testReadExternalAllowedHeader
methods.description: Tests extraction of the authorization header from external headers.

methods.name: testHeaderFiltering
methods.description: Ensures that headers not recognized are filtered out.

methods.name: translateMixedExternalHeadersToDittoHeaders
methods.description: Verifies correct translation from external headers containing known and custom headers.

methods.name: tryToTranslateNullToExternalHeaders
methods.description: Checks that passing null to conversion to external headers throws exception.

methods.name: translateEmptyDittoHeadersToExternal
methods.description: Tests conversion of an empty DittoHeaders to external headers map.

methods.name: translateInternalOnlyDittoHeadersToExternal
methods.description: Ensures internal-only headers are not included in external headers.

methods.name: translateMixedDittoHeadersToExternal
methods.description: Verifies translation of mixed DittoHeaders containing known headers and custom headers.

methods.name: translateDittoHeadersWithAckRequestToExternal
methods.description: Tests conversion of DittoHeaders with acknowledgment requests to external headers.

methods.name: translateMixedDittoHeadersRetainKnownHeaders
methods.description: Verifies selective retention of known headers during translation.
